briefdescription.para: Collect all potential values LI could read into PotentialValues.

detaileddescription.para: That is, the only values read by LI are assumed to be known and all are in PotentialValues. memberdef.name: isPotentiallyReachable

briefdescription.para: Return true if ToI is potentially reachable from FromI without running into any instruction in ExclusionSet The two instructions do not need to be in the same function.

detaileddescription.para: GoBackwardsCB can be provided to convey domain knowledge about the "lifespan" the user is interested in. By default, the callers of FromI are checked as well to determine if ToI can be reached. If the query is not interested in callers beyond a certain point, e.g., a GPU kernel entry or the function containing an alloca, the GoBackwardsCB should return false.
